title: Kicked Citrusy Vietnamese Beef Noodles
description: A citrusy and refreshing Vietnamese dish featuring beef cutlet, perfect for a post-workout meal, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients, served in a mason jar.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, turmeric, black pepper, and salt.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl and toss to combine with the sauce.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat and add the beef cutlet, cooking for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Let the beef rest for a few minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Add the sliced beef to the bowl with the noodles and sauce, and toss to combine.
Divide the mixture among four mason jars and serve immediately.
